The critic scores on those four are scores of the wrong picture, so another redesign would be wasted. The best versions stay the v31.82 pictures in `tools/handoff/console/notes/shots/12-r7-after`. I added this stop to `tools/handoff/console/notes/12-ui-party-screens.md`.

A next run is worth doing only once those four stages are restaged to show their named states.
